captures.title: Vows and trials
captures.text:
Vows and trials
▾
Vows and tempering

A vow trades freedom for strength and leaves a scar if broken. Tempering sets the body for good; a failed attempt wakes a heart demon that dulls you until you sit it out.

Vows (0 of 2 kept)

Long watch: Rise before the village does and keep the first hour to yourself. +6% body, scar 1 if broken. (not sworn) Hard early hours harden the frame. Swear

Plain table: Eat only plain fare and refuse every feast. +5% step, scar 2 if broken. (not sworn) A light belly keeps the feet quick. Swear

Open hand: Take nothing you did not earn with your own hands. +5% hand
